name: MNQ Absorption Test
hypothesis: After price closes more than k ATRs below its own moving average, the displacement is disproportionately the result of impatient selling into a thin book, and price should revert toward the average as liquidity replenishes over the following bars.
falsifiable_prediction: Reversion must be measurably stronger in the low-volatility half of the sample than in the high-volatility half, because absorption is easier in a calm book. Equal or inverted behaviour disproves the mechanism.
